slides.title: Coming soon: Agent-ready codebases
slides.summary: How to set up a codebase so coding agents do good work in it. This chapter is on its way.
body: A coding agent is only as good as the feedback your codebase gives it. An agent-ready codebase tells the agent how things work, and catches its mistakes fast.

ul: Fast, reliable tests the agent can run
Types, linters and formatters as guardrails
Clear structure and docs an agent can find
